pages.title: Smoother Riding
pages.text: A ridden horse should feel responsive. Better Horses fixes a list of small frictions vanilla horses used to have.

pages.title: Step Up & Mine Through
pages.text:
- Step height is raised by a tenth, so a galloping horse doesn't trip over slabs, paths, or full blocks.
- Mounted block-breaking now matches on-foot speed for most blocks.
- Whatever penalty is left after that is cut to a fifth.

pages.title: Look Around Freely
pages.text: Mounting no longer snaps your camera to the horse's facing - the **horse turns to match you** instead. Standing still, you get up to **90 degrees** of free look before the horse follows, so you can scan the horizon without dismounting.

pages.title: Out of Your Way
pages.text: Look down and the horse fades nearly invisible so it doesn't block your work or aim. While ridden, its head also drops forward to clear your view.

pages.title: Creative Convenience
pages.text: Using a **Saddle** (vanilla or upgraded) on a horse in **Creative Mode** tames it instantly - no waiting on hearts. Useful when testing builds.
